data.one_liner: A flutter package to allow drag-and-drop reordering of two-level lists.
data.what_it_does: Allows drag-and-drop reordering of elements within and between multiple lists, as well as reordering the lists themselves. Supports both vertical and horizontal layouts, drag handles, expansion tiles, and slivers.
use_when: You need to implement two-level reorderable lists with drag-and-drop support.
You want to reorder items between multiple separate lists or reorder the lists themselves.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, single-level reorderable list that is already provided by Flutter's standard ReorderableListView.
strengths: Supports reordering items between multiple lists and reordering lists themselves.
Supports both vertical and horizontal layouts, expansion tiles, and slivers.
Provides flexibility with drag handles, long presses, or short presses.
weaknesses: Scope is limited strictly to two-level drag-and-drop lists.
